title: Package a skill and a command as a plugin
goal: Build fm-team-kit, a minimal plugin with a manifest, one skill (pr-description) and one command (changelog), following SPEC.md. Fix the draft command that was saved in the wrong folder. Validate it with the script and with the real validator, load it in a session, and run both parts. Stretch: list it in a team marketplace.json and install it by name.

starter_prompts.claude: Read SPEC.md. Build the plugin in plugin/ exactly as specified: the manifest at plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, the skill at plugin/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md, and the command at plugin/commands/changelog.md. A draft of the command is already in the repo but in a folder where Claude Code will not load it: find it, move it, and give it the frontmatter the spec asks for. Run `npm run validate` and `claude plugin validate ./plugin` until both pass. Do not edit anything under tests/ or scripts/. Then tell me how to load it for one session with --plugin-dir and which command to run to try it.
starter_prompts.codex: Read SPEC.md. Build the plugin in plugin/ exactly as specified: the manifest at plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, the skill at plugin/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md, and the command at plugin/commands/changelog.md (commands are a Claude Code feature and the Codex docs list no plugin commands, but the check still wants the file). A draft of the command is already in the repo but in a folder where it will not load: find it, move it, and give it the frontmatter the spec asks for. Run `npm run validate` until it passes. Do not edit anything under tests/ or scripts/. Then add a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the repo root that lists the plugin, and tell me the `codex plugin marketplace add` and `codex plugin add` commands to install it, and how to remove both afterwards.

solution_notes: A plugin is a folder with a manifest and component folders at its root. Only plugin.json belongs in .claude-plugin/. The draft command was inside .claude-plugin/commands/, so it would never have loaded, and nothing reports an error: Claude Code's own validator does not flag it, and the plugin simply loads with fewer components. `claude plugin details fm-team-kit` shows the count (Skills (0)). This repo's script flags it so you notice.

The manifest pins version 1.0.0. With a version set, people keep the copy they have until you bump it, so a release is an explicit act. Leave version out and every new commit reaches them. The team rule here is to pin.

The command and the skill are both just Markdown with frontmatter. In a plugin they are namespaced as /fm-team-kit:changelog and /fm-team-kit:pr-description, so two plugins can ship a skill with the same name without colliding.

The optional marketplace.json is what turns a folder into something teammates install by name: add the marketplace once, install fm-team-kit@first-mate-team, and enable it for the repo. The entry name must equal the plugin's own name, and a relative source starts with ./ and is written from the marketplace root.
